findings.title: Exness-branded XAUUSDm historical Bid/Ask archive route
findings.current_interpretation: The current frozen Exness-branded XAUUSDm archive coverage contains 134 AVAILABLE months from 2015-08 through 2026-09, and every AVAILABLE month has a latest Validator V0.2 VALIDATED record. This closes the current acquisition/structural-validation coverage task, while tick continuity, duplicate representation, and exact equivalence to the current Exness Demo/MT5 server remain separate residual questions.

observations.statement: The live archive listing exposed XAUUSDm years 2015 through 2026 and the September 2022 monthly ZIP was downloadable from the Owner machine.

observations.statement: The September 2022 CSV contained 2,377,326 ticks with millisecond UTC Timestamp, Bid and Ask; the full-month scan found zero symbol/source mismatches, Ask < Bid rows, non-finite prices, timestamp regressions, or consecutive exact duplicate rows.

The frozen 2015-2026 coverage snapshot contains 134 AVAILABLE months and the latest Validator V0.2 manifest contains 134 matching validated months with 379,942,589 ticks and 3,430,625,119 ZIP bytes; provider mismatch, symbol mismatch, Ask < Bid, non-finite Bid/Ask and timestamp regression counts are all zero. Equal timestamps, exact duplicate rows, partial-month boundaries and the unresolved 2016 March/April boundary-gap candidate are preserved rather than silently repaired.
observations.representation: Current-coverage acquisition reconciliation using the latest V0.2 record per AVAILABLE month.

observations.statement: In the bounded already-inspected overlap 2026-08-02T22:02:00Z through 23:02:00Z, archive Bid-derived M1 produced 60 bars with 60/60 timestamps matching the saved MT5 M1 export, while 50/60 bars had at least one exact OHLC mismatch. findings.title: Exness remote archive rotated from daily subdirectories to month-only ZIP
findings.current_interpretation: The 2026-10-08 current-day input route assumed Exness daily subdirectories would remain available alongside the monthly ZIP. On the 2026-11-05 recheck, every 2026-10 daily snapshot returned REMOTE_DAY_NOT_AVAILABLE while the month-only ZIP exists and contains the 2026-10-08 00:00 UTC boundary-minute ticks. The checkpoint data is observable, but only through a route the frozen daily runner does not use. Route choice is an open owner decision. OBS-0016 adds a timing constraint on the month route: the ZIP rebuilt at about 01:41Z carried data only through the previous day's final tick, so that day's own boundary minute was not in it yet, while a long-closed day's boundary minute is (OBS-0011). A month-only route therefore serves a 07:00 boundary roughly a day after it occurs, and whether the day path serves it sooner is a separate, unperformed check.

observations.statement: The unchanged daily-route runner re-run on 2026-11-05 returned BLOCKED / BOUNDARY_MINUTE_NOT_AVAILABLE with all snapshots 2026-10-01..2026-10-08 REMOTE_DAY_NOT_AVAILABLE, including days previously VALIDATED.
Direct remote probes showed the 2026-10 month directory listing empty, daily paths 404, and the month ZIP Exness_XAUUSDm_2026_10.zip present at 55,936,122 bytes with a single month CSV entry.
conditions: same source family as the validated 2026-10-07 route

observations.statement: Streaming the live October month ZIP found 269 ticks inside the 2026-10-08 00:00 UTC boundary minute, first tick 00:00:00.017Z Bid 4108.073.

findings.title: Owner verbatim transcripts re-attribute the H4=1,500 statement and the visual path is closed for numerics
findings.current_interpretation: The 2026-11-05 owner-supplied verbatim transcripts bind to the 2026-09-12 intake hash pair (156353e5... / efc27e08...), which is byte-different from the '(1)' pair used by the 2026-10-08 visual review. Under that binding, the utterance transcribed as 'H4 1,500' belongs to VID_20260912_164004, while VID_20260912_163822 labels 1,500 as the TP2 extension of the same H1 round; the 2026-10-08 checkpoint attributed all three distances to 163822. The frozen H4_RUN_POINTS = 1500.0 keeps direct verbatim support, so no canonical value is invalidated, but the two readings are not reconciled here. Dense-frame review additionally establishes that this source contains no numeric text anywhere, so the visual escalation path cannot arbitrate timeframes, point distances, the stop buffer, or the '>50%' relation; those remain audio/transcript-only evidence. Resolving the remaining readings requires a better-audio pass or direct owner/instructor clarification, both decision-critical and requiring WO-055 admission before any canonical change.

observations.statement: Verbatim timestamps place the 'H1 1,000' and 'H4 1,500' readings inside VID_20260912_164004 (00:30-00:48), while VID_20260912_163822 gives 1,500 as the TP2 extension counted from the same point (01:15-01:31) and then states Day = 5,000 after an audible self-repair. The 2026-10-08 checkpoint itemises H1=1,000 / H4=1,500 / Day=5,000 under its 'Video 2 (163822)' heading.
observations.representation: Owner timestamped transcript text compared line-by-line against the 2026-10-08 per-video itemisation.
conditions: transcripts bound by SHA-256 to the 2026-09-12 intake pair 156353e5.../efc27e08...
